organizations_ordering_pause_check.name: organizations_ordering_pause_check
organizations_ordering_pause_check.value:
("organizations"."ordering_paused_at" IS NULL) = ("organizations"."ordering_paused_by" IS NULL)
      AND ("organizations"."ordering_paused_at" IS NOT NULL OR "organizations"."ordering_paused_reason" IS NULL)
      AND ("organizations"."ordering_paused_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("organizations"."ordering_paused_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)
      AND ("organizations"."ordering_paused_until" IS NULL OR ("organizations"."ordering_paused_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organizations"."ordering_paused_until" > "organizations"."ordering_paused_at"))

orders_channel_fulfilment_coherent.name: orders_channel_fulfilment_coherent
orders_channel_fulfilment_coherent.value:
(
        ("orders"."channel" = 'DINE_IN' AND "orders"."fulfilment" = 'DINE_IN')
        OR ("orders"."channel" = 'TAKEAWAY' AND "orders"."fulfilment" = 'TAKEAWAY')
        OR ("orders"."channel" = 'ONLINE' AND "orders"."fulfilment" IN ('TAKEAWAY', 'DELIVERY'))
      )

payments_cash_holder_check.name: payments_cash_holder_check
payments_cash_holder_check.value: ("payments"."handover_id" IS NULL OR "payments"."held_by_rider") AND (NOT "payments"."held_by_rider" OR ("payments"."handover_id" IS NULL) = ("payments"."cash_session_id" IS NULL))

refunds_idempotency_key_check.name: refunds_idempotency_key_check
refunds_idempotency_key_check.value: "refunds"."idempotency_key" IS NULL OR char_length("refunds"."idempotency_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

iq_actions_auto_policy_check.name: iq_actions_auto_policy_check
iq_actions_auto_policy_check.value:
("iq_actions"."auto_policy_id" IS NULL) = ("iq_actions"."auto_policy_version" IS NULL)
          AND ("iq_actions"."auto_policy_id" IS NULL OR "iq_actions"."tier" = 'A1')

iq_actions_mode_status_check.name: iq_actions_mode_status_check
iq_actions_mode_status_check.value:
(("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A0' OR ("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A1' AND "iq_actions"."auto_policy_id" IS NOT NULL)) AND "iq_actions"."status" IN ('QUEUED', 'EXECUTING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'UNDONE'))
          OR (("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A2' OR ("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A1' AND "iq_actions"."auto_policy_id" IS NULL)) AND "iq_actions"."status" IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL', 'APPROVED', 'EXECUTING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'REJECTED', 'EXPIRED', 'SUPERSEDED', 'CANCELLED', 'UNDONE'))
          OR ("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A3' AND "iq_actions"."status" IN ('HANDOFF', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED', 'SUPERSEDED'))

iq_actions_approved_by_check.name: iq_actions_approved_by_check
iq_actions_approved_by_check.value:
CASE WHEN ("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A2' OR ("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A1' AND "iq_actions"."auto_policy_id" IS NULL)) AND "iq_actions"."status" IN ('APPROVED', 'EXECUTING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'UNDONE')
            THEN "iq_actions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "iq_actions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL
          WHEN ("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A2' OR ("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A1' AND "iq_actions"."auto_policy_id" IS NULL)) THEN true
          ELSE "iq_actions"."approved_by" IS NULL AND "iq_actions"."approved_at" IS NULL END

iq_actions_approval_expiry_check.name: iq_actions_approval_expiry_check
iq_actions_approval_expiry_check.value: NOT (("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A2' OR ("iq_actions"."tier" = 'A1' AND "iq_actions"."auto_policy_id" IS NULL)) OR "iq_actions"."tier" = 'A3') OR "iq_actions"."approval_expires_at" IS NOT NULL

iq_auto_policies_limits_check.name: iq_auto_policies_limits_check
iq_auto_policies_limits_check.value:
CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("iq_auto_policies"."limits") = 'object'
            AND ("iq_auto_policies"."limits" - 'maxPerDay') = '{}'::jsonb
            AND jsonb_typeof("iq_auto_policies"."limits" -> 'maxPerDay') = 'number'
          THEN ("iq_auto_policies"."limits" ->> 'maxPerDay')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 50
            AND ("iq_auto_policies"."limits" ->> 'maxPerDay')::numeric = trunc(("iq_auto_policies"."limits" ->> 'maxPerDay')::numeric)
          ELSE false END

iq_insights_trust_score_check.name: iq_insights_trust_score_check
iq_insights_trust_score_check.value: ("iq_insights"."trust_state" = 'MEASURED') = ("iq_insights"."trust_score" IS NOT NULL AND "iq_insights"."trust_as_of" IS NOT NULL) AND ("iq_insights"."trust_score" IS NULL OR "iq_insights"."trust_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

iq_insights_copy_check.name: iq_insights_copy_check
iq_insights_copy_check.value:
CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("iq_insights"."copy") = 'object'
            AND ("iq_insights"."copy" - 'templateId' - 'slots') = '{}'::jsonb
            AND jsonb_typeof("iq_insights"."copy" -> 'templateId') = 'string'
            AND jsonb_typeof("iq_insights"."copy" -> 'slots') = 'object'
          THEN ("iq_insights"."copy" ->> 'templateId') ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]*$'
            AND char_length("iq_insights"."copy" ->> 'templateId') <= 120
            AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("iq_insights"."copy" -> 'slots', '$.keyvalue() ? (!(@.key like_regex "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]*$"))')
            AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("iq_insights"."copy" -> 'slots', '$.* ? (@.type() != "string")')
            AND NOT jsonb_path_exists("iq_insights"."copy" -> 'slots', '$.* ? (!(@ like_regex "^[A-Za-z0-9_]+([.][A-Za-z0-9_]+)*$"))')
          ELSE false END

iq_insights_trust_detail_check.name: iq_insights_trust_detail_check
iq_insights_trust_detail_check.value:
array_position("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids", NULL) IS NULL
          AND array_position("iq_insights"."trust_reasons", NULL) IS NULL
          AND cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids") <= 50
          AND cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_reasons") <= 50
          AND (array_to_string("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids", ',') ~ '^([a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]*(,[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.:-]*)*)?$'
            AND length(array_to_string("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids", ',')) - length(replace(array_to_string("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids", ','), ',', '')) = greatest(cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids") - 1, 0)
            AND (array_to_string("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids", ',') = '') = (cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids") = 0))
          AND (array_to_string("iq_insights"."trust_reasons", ',') ~ '^([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*(,[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)*)?$'
            AND length(array_to_string("iq_insights"."trust_reasons", ',')) - length(replace(array_to_string("iq_insights"."trust_reasons", ','), ',', '')) = greatest(cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_reasons") - 1, 0)
            AND (array_to_string("iq_insights"."trust_reasons", ',') = '') = (cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_reasons") = 0))
          AND CASE "iq_insights"."trust_state"
            WHEN 'MEASURED' THEN cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids") >= 1
            WHEN 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA' THEN cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_reasons") >= 1 AND cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids") = 0
            ELSE cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_metric_ids") = 0 AND cardinality("iq_insights"."trust_reasons") = 0
          END

iq_insights_status_reason_check.name: iq_insights_status_reason_check
iq_insights_status_reason_check.value:
"iq_insights"."status_reason" IS NULL
          OR ("iq_insights"."status_reason" IN ('CLEARED', 'CLOSING_TIME', 'SUPERSEDED', 'RETRACTED') AND CASE "iq_insights"."status_reason"
            WHEN 'SUPERSEDED' THEN "iq_insights"."status" = 'SUPERSEDED'
            WHEN 'RETRACTED' THEN "iq_insights"."status" = 'RETRACTED'
            ELSE "iq_insights"."status" = 'EXPIRED'
          END)

iq_insights_supersede_check.name: iq_insights_supersede_check
iq_insights_supersede_check.value: ("iq_insights"."supersedes" IS NULL OR "iq_insights"."supersedes" <> "iq_insights"."id") AND ("iq_insights"."superseded_by" IS NULL OR ("iq_insights"."superseded_by" <> "iq_insights"."id" AND "iq_insights"."status" = 'SUPERSEDED'))

iq_recommendations_decided_by_check.name: iq_recommendations_decided_by_check
iq_recommendations_decided_by_check.value: "iq_recommendations"."status" NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'DISMISSED') OR "iq_recommendations"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL

closed_dates_note_check.name: closed_dates_note_check
closed_dates_note_check.value: "closed_dates"."public_note" IS NULL OR char_length("closed_dates"."public_note") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

cash_handovers_note_check.name: cash_handovers_note_check
cash_handovers_note_check.value: "cash_handovers"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("cash_handovers"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

cash_sessions_closed_check.name: cash_sessions_closed_check
cash_sessions_closed_check.value:
("cash_sessions"."status" = 'OPEN' AND "cash_sessions"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "cash_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "cash_sessions"."counted_cash" IS NULL AND "cash_sessions"."expected_cash" IS NULL AND "cash_sessions"."variance" IS NULL)
        OR ("cash_sessions"."status" = 'CLOSED' AND "cash_sessions"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_sessions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_sessions"."counted_cash" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_sessions"."expected_cash" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_sessions"."variance" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_sessions"."counted_cash" >= 0 AND "cash_sessions"."variance" = "cash_sessions"."counted_cash" - "cash_sessions"."expected_cash")

cash_sessions_note_check.name: cash_sessions_note_check
cash_sessions_note_check.value: "cash_sessions"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("cash_sessions"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 200
